name: Transcorp Power Plc
source: Transcorp Power Plc audited annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024, Five-Year Financial Summary page 84, printed in thousands of naira; values stored below as absolute naira. FY2024 to FY2020 are the audited five-year summary. The FY2025 column is carried over unchanged from the previous stored source (no audited FY2025 filing was available locally) and its income tax is shown with the same negative sign convention as the audited years. EPS is not printed in this five-year summary. | CRON 20261002: EPS added from Transcorp Power Plc audited annual report FY2024, consolidated statement of profit or loss page 35 and note 14 page 71, printed "Basic and diluted earnings per share (N)" FY2024 10.67 and FY2023 4.03 (FY2023 restated on 7,500,000,000 shares per note 34). Ties: stored FY2024 net profit 80,013,268,000 divided by 7,500,000,000 shares equals 10.67, and stored FY2023 net profit 30,233,530,000 divided by 7,500,000,000 equals 4.03. Years not printed in the five-year summary are left empty. | CRON 20261002: Income rows filled from Transcorp Power Plc audited annual report FY2024, consolidated statement of profit or loss page 35, printed in thousands of naira, stored here as absolute naira. Printed FY2024/FY2023: Cost of sales 163,733,739 / 66,700,227; Gross profit 142,209,895 / 75,422,137; Operating profit 114,031,097 / 64,625,141; Finance income 7,342,864 / 3,009,908; Finance cost 9,858,358 / 7,694,081. Ties: Revenue less Cost of sales equals Gross profit exactly (142,209,895 and 75,422,137); Gross profit less Operating Expenses equals the printed Operating profit; Operating profit less Net Finance Costs plus the printed Other gain/(loss) of 1,771,593 / (7,177,267) equals the printed Profit before income tax exactly. Operating Expenses is not a printed subtotal: it is the net amount the issuer deducts between Gross profit and Operating profit (administrative expenses 20,090,766 plus impairment loss on financial assets 8,109,188 less other operating income 21,156 for FY2024; 8,663,021 plus 2,731,924 less 597,949 for FY2023). Net Finance Costs is finance cost less finance income. FY2022 to FY2020 are not printed in this statement so those cells stay empty.
